app.name: TinyFix
app.tagline: Fix the text you are typing
donut.hint_pages: Page {0} of {1}: Tab or mouse wheel for more
donut.needs_ai: Set up an AI model in Settings to use this skill.
donut.ai_hint: Set up an AI model in Settings to use this skill.
donut.page_hint: Press the menu shortcut in any app to open it. Tab or the mouse wheel flips pages.
settings.title: TinyFix Settings
settings.keep_previous: Keep the original text on the clipboard after a change
settings.change_toast: Show a notice with Undo after a change
status.undo_failed: Could not undo. Press Ctrl+Z in your app.
status.moved: {0}: the selection changed meanwhile, so nothing was pasted. The result is on your clipboard.
skills.desc: Each skill has a name, a prompt, an input mode and an optional shortcut.
skills.name: Name
shortcut.need_modifier: Add Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win, or use an F key.
variables.help: In a skill prompt, {{name}} inserts the value with that name. {{content}} is the selected text. {{language}} is built in (it cannot be removed) and is the language Translate writes in. A value is copied as written.
variables.name: Name
variables.invalid: Use letters, digits and underscores, and do not start with a digit.
variables.reserved: The name content is reserved for the selected text.
models.desc: Fixes and rewrites text in any language with an AI model of your choice.
models.fallback_help: Used when the main model times out, cannot be reached, is rate limited (HTTP 429), returns a server error (HTTP 5xx), or returns nothing.
models.secret_warning: No system keyring was found: API keys are kept in an encrypted file that other programs of your account can read.
models.privacy: Only the selected text and your prompt are sent to the provider you choose. TinyFix never logs your text or your key.
updates.desc: TinyFix can check GitHub for a newer release.
updates.auto: Check for updates once a day
updates.installing: Installing the update. TinyFix restarts by itself.
about.description: TinyFix fixes typos and rewrites text in any app with a shortcut.
about.experimental: Linux and macOS support is experimental and has not been tested on real machines yet.
about.translations: Translations are machine-generated and welcome a review.
status.ai_off: Set up an AI model in Settings to use this skill.
status.nothing_selected: Nothing selected, or the selection could not be copied
status.timeout: {0} timed out; the text was left unchanged
status.failed: {0} failed; the text was left unchanged
status.hook_failed: Global shortcuts could not start. On macOS, allow TinyFix under Privacy and Security, Accessibility.
status.wayland: This is a Wayland session: global shortcuts may not work. Use Fix clipboard from the tray menu.
setup.welcome.title: Select text, press a shortcut, get it fixed
setup.welcome.subtitle: TinyFix lives in the tray and rewrites the text you are typing.
setup.welcome.benefit_fix: Fixes typos in any app, in the language of the text.
setup.welcome.benefit_skills: Translate, rewrite, or run a skill you write yourself.
setup.welcome.benefit_donut: Opens the donut menu beside the caret so you can pick a skill.
setup.model.title: Choose an AI model
setup.model.subtitle: Skills send the selected text to this model.
setup.model.later_help: You can add a model in Settings. Skills need a model before they can run.
setup.model.need_model: Enter a model id to continue, or choose Set up later.
setup.model.need_key: Add an API key to continue, or choose Set up later.
setup.model.need_url: Enter a base URL to continue, or choose Set up later.
setup.test_network: TinyFix could not reach the server.
setup.test_timeout: The server did not answer in time.
setup.provider.ollama: Runs on your computer. No key needed.
setup.provider.lmstudio: Runs on your computer. No key needed.
setup.skills.title: Choose skills and shortcuts
setup.skills.subtitle: Turn a skill on, or click its shortcut to change it.
setup.skills.menu_desc: Opens the ring of skills beside the caret.
setup.skill.fix-all.desc: Selects the whole field, then corrects it.
setup.skill.translate.desc: Translates the selection into your target language.
setup.skill.rewrite.desc: Rewrites the selection so it reads more clearly.
setup.skill.rewrite-language.desc: Rewrites the selection in your target language.
setup.skill.improve-prompt.desc: Turns a rough prompt into a clearer one.
setup.done.title: You are ready
setup.done.subtitle: You can change any of this later in Settings.
setup.done.note: Shortcuts, the model, and skills all live in Settings.
